section_summary: This section documents administrative directives and individual applications concerning travel, foreign trade, and property controls for occupied Japan in early 1949. Central items include SCAPIN 1966 governing customs and currency rules for entering and departing individuals, and the revised Guide for Commercial Entrants outlining procedures for foreign business representatives. The documents also include State Department correspondence processing military entry permits for trade representatives, missionaries, and humanitarian visitors.

subfiles.summary: Transmits GHQ SCAP directive SCAPIN 1966 of January 18, 1949, and an explanatory press release of January 25, 1949, revising customs controls. The directive governs property, foreign exchange, and currencies carried by individuals entering or leaving Japan. It liberalizes property allowances for Korean, Formosan, Ryukyuan, and Chinese repatriates, permitting unaccompanied shipment of household effects and up to 4,000 pounds of professional tools.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 64: Customs Controls on Property Brought in or Taken out of Japan

subfiles.summary: Transmits copies of the revised January 1949 Guide for Commercial Entrants issued by SCAP's Economic and Scientific Section. The guide provides practical information for foreign business entrants on entry procedures, housing, finances, communications, medical care, and trade operations. It includes texts of SCAP Circular No. 1, Circular No. 2, and regulations governing foreign investment and property acquisition during the Occupation.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 70: Forwarding Guide for Commercial Entrants to Japan
